about: Minecraft spawn eggs that place a New Vegas NPC where you use them. The egg is a vanilla egg item with a custom name and custom_data {osl_npc:id}; using it on a block sends 'spawnnpc' to New Vegas, which places the NPC there. /mojave egg <id> [count] gives them.

columns.name: egg's name in Minecraft
columns.nv_names: New Vegas NPC names (FULL) to look for, in order
columns.egg_item: vanilla spawn egg it looks like
